plugins.description: The Aqmen connector plus skills by use case: a CDD end to end; the shared steps — scope, research, model, challenge, conclude, deliver, refresh, demo prep; and the proposal and storyline before the work. Each engagement is a project in the client's workspace; deliverables are decks and docs with every figure sourced, exportable to PowerPoint and Word.
